05 / WHAT IS BUILT

INPUT

Replay evidence

Camera · thermal · wind

→
SHARED SERVICES

Python + typed tools

Scenario facts · geometry checks

→
OUTPUT

Draft + review

Working in this demo

MapLibre workspace, route exclusion, editable drafts, approval gate and audit trail.

Server integrations implemented

Bedrock tool loop, read-only MCP server, FIRMS / weather / OSRM adapters, ntfy relay.

Require configuration. Live feeds are not fused into this replay.

Verification, with limits

19 core automated checks passed across geometry, workflow and mocked Bedrock responses.

No measured detection accuracy, delivery SLA or field validation.

Bedrock uses shared tool functions via Converse. The standalone MCP server exposes the same services; MCP transport is not yet wired into the Bedrock runner.
